title: The Griffiths exponent of random-field Ising dynamics at strong Gaussian disorder

comparators.scope: 31 fixed explicit contracts covering numbered theorem engines, actual RFIM Theorem 1.3, both actual Gaussian probability propositions, and the general iid lower bound; the Corollary 1.4 contract is only the exponent identity.

comparators.rejection_detail: Added False premise changes the general iid lower-bound type

main_results.scope: For d >= 2 and beta,sigma > 0, SurfaceSlowPureBoxes and StrongGaussianDisorder imply simultaneous relaxation/mixing-time bounds and both truncated double-log limits in probability.
For d >= 2 and beta > 0, SurfaceSlowPureBoxes gives the Gaussian lower bound at every fixed positive variance.
The lower bound for iid real fields with polynomial small-ball probability, both shell-tail probabilities positive at the stated threshold, and the surface-slow pure-box input.
The dimension-two exponent identity (2-1)/2 = 1/2 only; the unconditional low-temperature corollary requires an external Ising gap theorem.
